title: Bioprinting and 3D Printing Human Body Parts
description: Explores the ways that 3D printing and 3D bioprinting are revolutionizing available treatments for medical needs. Describes how 3D bioprinting requires collaboration between biomedical engineers, scientists and critically - clinicians. Ethical considerations and ramifications of technological advances. Includes a design project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of BME 510, BME 401B (if taken in the same topic), BME 410.
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.
